game_concept: A puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard, an echoing courtyard: the relic hunter must handle eldritch shades while practicing lists. Core idea – Search Scout: Use in and index() to find where a hidden item sits in a list.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard: an echoing courtyard
core_gameplay_loop: In Echoing Courtyard, repeat each round: Use in and index() to find where a hidden item sits in a list. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the found value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the obelisk using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the obelisk is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 3 (intro tier): Search Scout
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Search Scout' (Week 7 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Echoing Courtyard'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how found changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against eldritch shades in Echoing Courtyard.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The obelisk reached with actions_used <= 19.
